verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a built-in AI agent platform where users can create, configure and manage agents with MCP tools attached, which is the closest first-party capability to autonomous automations. However, nothing in the evidence shows these agents running unattended in the background, and the `local-ai chat` shell agent is explicitly interactive behind an approval gate. missing for 10: documented background/unattended agent execution, scheduling or event triggers, automation lifecycle management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
